The RA may allow extension of the said period for submission of certificate, upto valid EO period with a payment of a composition fee of Rs. 10,000/- per year by the authorisation holder. Where the authorisation holder opts for independent Chartered Engineer’s certificate, he shall send a copy of the certificate to the jurisdictional Customs Authority for intimation/record. The authorization holder shall be permitted to shift capital goods during the entire export obligation period to other units mentioned in the IEC and RCMC of the authorization holder subject to production of fresh installation certificate to the RA concerned within six months of the shifting. (a) Deleted.
